Flat ordinary-entry and ordered plain-sibling completion is checked at source checkpoint f75c088bed6a1848dccdf97e63839ceb8cd09ddb (runtime commit 7edb0f9da601fa4bcfcd5137fbd364dcdcfa9ebb). Eight new modules / 15 public theorems. Every sibling restores the SAME captured enumeration cache while threading the actual reached native Caller and Queries. Original admission derives actual flat completion at every adequate native bound, for every related initial flat cache. The ENTIRE earlier packet remains: Post/full global Memos, every receipt's prefix postcondition, pending references and fragment histories, complete-or-unhandled shape, and the condition for finishing all supported alternatives. Receipt consumers derive native index correctness at each receipt's OWN heap/cache from that retained old admission and the actual relation. An absent-cache receipt asserts no cache correctness; valid rejection does not imply Safe.

Hook-aware sibling and ordinary runtimes execute each completed edge's continuation BEFORE the next sibling. They preserve output order, exact stopping stage and actual optional endpoint. Identity bridges hold at ALL inputs and bounds. Heterogeneous output/failure relations support the different flat and earlier representations; the cache-free hook result is shared with the existing flat callback continuation. These are runtime equations and identity bridges, NOT original-admission completion for arbitrary or concrete recursive hooks.

Next recursive obligation: a sibling starts at the actual POST-HOOK native endpoint. Plain branch Ranges only follows the head's pre-hook endpoint and cannot establish post-hook admission. Compose concrete callback/recursive Output and Failure correspondence and the original finite-depth resource induction at the actual returned endpoint. No future flat observation or desired final flat invariant is added as a premise.

All eight modules and Audit pass strict Lean 4.34.1 checks. Aggregate Audit: 4042 jobs / 78840 theorem dependency checks. Installed readback: 17 signatures (15 new plus unchanged H6 and captured rendering), 21 complete definitions, 81616 bytes SHA256 af32a4def6068542efdeb7c63307ef288a751973fcf23c4f144d189643326795. Only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. Main remains 82258094c2c32bb93e517427bc649a5c7077adac after pull/fetch. No Haskell source changed. FINDINGS retains every repair handoff and the open extraction-progress limitation.

H6 remains the strongest global finite-tree language theorem for covered closed construction and original guard-allocation histories. Whole recursive correspondence, output soundness, coverage, pruning-policy soundness, initial admission histories and full physical Haskell correspondence remain open. Full goal stays ACTIVE. Handoff: lean/notes-current-flat-native-branches.md. Reviewed evidence and the authorized formalize checkpoint push are being prepared.
